{{Top|leg}}
'''Regulation X7T-PLX''' was an internal regulation used by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] that restricted the use of the [[Battlefield Holographic Control Interface]] to control Imperial Military personnel and munitions while under the influence of an intoxicant detrimental to focused and loyal thought.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]'' {{C|Game manual}}
